text:
kevin: Heads up — migrating one of our sample apps to webpack 5 + ts-loader and hit a weird combo of issues only when deployed to Vercel Edge: duplicated Authorization header on retry + TS language server not resolving types for the ESM entry. Node + local dev are fine.

talia: can you paste minimal repro steps?

kevin: steps: 
1) git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps -b webpack-edge-repro
2) cd next-webpack-edge
3) npm ci
4) REDWOOD_API_KEY=wrong npm run build && npm run start:edge
5) curl -v http://localhost:3000/api/llm

handler: 
```ts
// pages/api/llm.ts
import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const ans = await client.generate({ prompt: 'hey' });
  const txt = await ans.text();
  res.status(200).send(txt);
}
```

ow run: response shows 401 then retry with header duplicated: 
"Authorization: Bearer BAD, Authorization: Bearer BAD"

owen: that strongly suggests the retry path is reusing a Headers instance. Which package entry are you importing? default vs named?

kevin: named ESM import: import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference'. If I switch to require() against dist/cjs it doesn't reproduce. Also VSCode shows no types for createClient when using ESM path — intellisense drops.

meredith: packaging smell. Our exports map might not point types to the ESM entry so TS falls back. For headers, Webpack might polyfill fetch/Headers differently; Vercel Edge uses a V8 isolate where headers cloning semantics can differ.

kevin: I tried a quick patch: in retry code replace new Request(oldReq) with explicit headers clone: 
```js
const headers = new Headers(oldReq.headers || {});
headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${apiKey}`);
const retryReq = new Request(oldReq, { headers });
```
That fixed duplication locally on the Vercel runner.

talia: good temporary fix. We should avoid depending on runtime clone semantics and always make a fresh Headers object. Also add unit tests that run built bundles through a worker-like shim.

owen: for TS issue, ensure package.json exports map includes "./package.json" "types" or add "types" under the export subpath for "import" target. Some bundlers (webpack with tsserver) rely on packageExports + types field to link .d.ts.

ci-bot: queued job: devex/webpack-edge-repro (#342) - matrix: vercel-edge, node-local-tsc.

meredith: action items: 
- kevin: push repro branch + minimal README (ETA today)
- owen: open PR to defensively clone headers in retry and run the new CI matrix (ETA tomorrow)
- talia: PR to package.json exports to ensure types resolved for ESM entry (ETA EOD)

kevin: one more note — when I enable terser/minify in webpack the dup-header becomes nondeterministic. Probably minifier changing closure layout. I'll record that in the issue: sdk#447.

owen: thanks — once CI runs we'll decide on a patch release if tests confirm fix across vercel/netlify/cloudflare.
